item.title: My Journey with GNOME Asia Summit 2022 Malaysia
item.description:
Day 0#

My day 0 is a travel to Malaysia, and this is first time for me. because I will try solo traveling to another country, and for trial I try going to Malaysia. My flight with Air Asia depart from Bandara International Soekarno Hatta to Kuala Lumpur. After landing on Kuala Lumpur International Airport at 2 AM. I ordered Grab Car from Airport to My Hotel. After arrived at hotel I am taking a rest for the summit.
